title: Gene expression profiling reveals insights into infant immunological and febrile responses to capsular group B meningococcal vaccine
description: We report gene expression profiles, using RNA-sequencing, in whole blood samples taken before and after infant immunisations. Overall design: To assess gene expression profiles following routine infant immunisations, and relate these to vaccine immunogenicity and reactogenicity.
